lines.text: After finishing the parables, Jesus goes to His hometown and teaches the people in their synagogue.
The people are astonished and ask where Jesus got such wisdom and miraculous powers.
They call Him the carpenter's son and name His mother Elizabeth and His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas.
They take offense at Him, and Jesus says a priest is without honor only in his hometown and household.
Jesus does not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
